entries.title: CLI update: use-send-message
entries.summary: CLI, Agent Runtime, SDK changes across 5 file(s) (+440/−9).

ai.title: Preserve user-interrupted message in SDK run state after Esc
ai.summary: The agent runtime extracts the hardcoded user-interrupted message into a new `USER_INTERRUPTED_MESSAGE` constant, which the SDK re-exports to allow external consumption. A new SDK function, `toUserInterruptedRunState`, inspects a `RunState` and swaps the SDK's generic cancellation text for `USER_INTERRUPTED_MESSAGE` when resuming an interrupted turn. The CLI incorporates this by calling `toUserInterruptedRunState` in its abort handler and post-run persistence path, ensuring the next prompt in the same chat resumes from a history that explicitly records the user stopped the agent, rather than a generic "session ended" state. Three test cases verify that this prevents the model from receiving contradictory context when the user hits Esc and types a follow-up prompt.
ai.evidence: In `packages/agent-runtime/src/util/messages.ts`, the string "User interrupted the response..." is extracted into `USER_INTERRUPTED_MESSAGE`. In `sdk/src/run.ts`, a new exported function `toUserInterruptedRunState` swaps an SDK's generic cancellation message for `USER_INTERRUPTED_MESSAGE` in the session state. In `cli/src/hooks/use-send-message.ts`, the abort handler and post-run persistence logic now call `toUserInterruptedRunState` to ensure the interrupted turn's history ends with the user-interrupted message.

changes.what: Extracted the user-interrupted message into the `USER_INTERRUPTED_MESSAGE` constant.
Added `toUserInterruptedRunState` to swap the SDK's cancellation message with the runtime's user-interrupted message.
Updated `useSendMessage` to apply `toUserInterruptedRunState` when a user interrupts a turn, ensuring the next prompt resumes from the correct history.

eli5.text: When you press the escape key to stop an AI coding task, the system now records that you personally stopped it, rather than treating it as a general session shutdown. This matters to anyone using the free terminal assistant: if you immediately type a follow-up instruction, the AI understands you paused the previous work and remembers what you were doing, so it does not get confused by contradictory context. Previously, a quick stop-and-continue could leave the AI thinking the session had crashed or ended naturally, leading to awkward restarts.

This extends the closed product funnel telemetry schema to support better diagnostic tracking for user sessions.

entries.title: Agents update: base-deep

ai.title: Mandate plain-text answer before followup suggestions call
ai.summary: This change updates agent prompts and tool descriptions across `base2`, `base3`, and `base-deep` to enforce a strict ordering where the model writes its plain-text answer before calling the followup suggestions tool. A new `CLI_FOLLOWUP_ORDER_RULE` constant in `agents/base3.ts` adapts the desktop guidance to the CLI context, addressing a failure mode where 40% of CLI sessions ended with suggestion cards but no answer. The `suggest_followups` tool description in `common/src/tools/params/tool/suggest-followups.ts` now explicitly instructs the model to never put the answer inside the tool call and to treat it as the very last action of the turn. This ensures the user sees the complete result before any interactive followup options are rendered.
ai.evidence: The diff introduces `CLI_FOLLOWUP_ORDER_RULE` in `agents/base3.ts` and updates the `suggest_followups` tool description in `common/src/tools/params/tool/suggest-followups.ts` to explicitly mandate writing the plain-text answer before calling the tool.
